status: INCONCLUSIVE -- not published as a comparison
why: A cross-CLI speed comparison needs a STABLE per-cell measurement. It is not stable yet: the same codex invocation that completed in 72s through the Loki provider layer later timed out at both 200s and 300s on the identical task and machine, while a trivial prompt answered in 9s. The CLI is healthy; the task-level result varies run to run.

measured_attempts.note: proves the CLI and auth are healthy; the variance is task-level
earlier same-day run, recorded in free-onramp.json

what_would_make_it_publishable: N trials per cell with median and spread, not a single sample. A one-sample-per-cell table would have reported 'codex: timeout' as a fact about codex when the same command had already succeeded in 72s, which would be a fabricated competitive claim.
not_claimed: No speed or quality ranking between CLIs is asserted. Nothing here compares tools.
